terms: USGS Water Services IV, provisional and subject to revision. See https://waterdata.usgs.gov/nwis/help/?provisional
citation: US Geological Survey, National Water Information System (NWIS), accessed 2026-10-13; sites 06036805 (Firehole River at Old Faithful) and 06036905 (Firehole River near West Yellowstone MT).
finding: Specific conductance (00095), dissolved oxygen (00300) and pH (00400) are not published as instantaneous values at either gauge for the fetched 8 day window. Historical daily values for specific conductance exist at 06036905 for 2010-05-13 to 2017-10-30 and at 06036805 for 2010-2017; these windows do not overlap the firehole_obs or met.json windows. Discrete water-quality samples are available through the Water Quality Portal and are the only source of paired chloride and conductance samples for a site-specific McCleskey-style fit.
